summary: Ingredion Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a $1.475B delayed draw term loan agreement with JPMorgan as administrative agent, comprising a $500M Tranche A-1 and $975M Tranche B-1 facility, to fund its announced cash offer for all issued share capital of Tate & Lyle PLC (UK). Terms include customary draw-stop events aligned with the UK Takeover Code; proceeds will also refinance certain Tate & Lyle debt. The facility expires February 2, 2028, extendable to August 3, 2028. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for regulatory clearance timelines and hedging transactions to convert USD to GBP; risk-arb spread depends on offer premium and UK competition review.
